title: Generation of triplet carbenes by oxidation of an allene compound
abstract: Computational analysis on the dicationic species generated upon two‐electron oxidation of the corresponding allenic compounds bearing two thioxanthene (7a) or two acridene (7b) moieties indicated that the ground‐state multiplicity would be of the triplet state (ΔEST = ECS − ET = 12.6 and 14 kcal/mol, respectively). Under this premise, oxidation reactions of 7a and 7b were carried out. In the case of 7b, oxidation with (p‐BrC6H4)3N•+SbCl6− gave a dimer (13), which could be presumed to have formed by dimerization of the corresponding carbene. Oxidation of 7b in the presence of tetramethylpiperidine N‐oxide afforded the corresponding ketone derivative (14), thus implying the likelihood of a triplet carbene being the reactive intermediate. These results suggest that double oxidation of heterocyclic allene compounds is viable as a new approach for generating triplet carbenes. Copyright © 2011 John Wiley & Sons, Ltd.
